storage: one gzipped JSONL per composite key <weekStartDate>__<tierIdentifier> under <archive>/finraweekly/ (gz-on-write — a populated tier runs 60k-200k+ rows); partition-level dedup per (week, tier)
written_by: server/finraQuery.ts refreshFinraAts (6h poll, newest 2 weekStartDate values × 4 tiers T1/T2/OTCE/NA — most tier/week combos are empty (204); no backfill built)
source: FINRA Query API weeklySummary (api.finra.org, keyless; contract live-verified 2026-07-08). Composite-key partitions [weekStartDate, tierIdentifier]. Weekly per-firm and per-symbol OTC/ATS volume, published ~T+3 weeks. A populated tier can exceed 60k rows/partition — fetched with a raised page cap (ATS_MAX_PAGES=50, 250k-row ceiling), not the part-1 default.
license: FINRA data, free with attribution; redistribution/resale of raw data needs FINRA license review before monetization

field_map.weekStartDate + tierIdentifier — partiti: week (Monday) + tier (T1/T2/OTCE/NA — NMS Tier 1/2, OTC Equity, N/A)
field_map.summaryTypeCode: granularity flag — *_SMBL_FIRM (per symbol per firm), *_SMBL (per symbol, all firms combined), *_FIRM (per firm, all symbols combined); ATS_ vs OTC_ prefix distinguishes venue type. Only *_SMBL rows are ranked (server-side) — mixing granularities double-counts volume.
field_map.issueSymbolIdentifier/issueName: populated on *_SMBL(_FIRM) rows only; null on *_FIRM rows

confidence_model: RAW official weekly ATS/OTC volume as disseminated by FINRA. No signal claim — a future settlement-stress or venue-concentration hypothesis is unstarted (gate 1 DATA only).
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). Census build #4 part 2 of 2 (wishlist.md DATACORE MAXIMUS FINRA PART 2 DESIGN NOTES) — the weeklySummary leg.
